scripts.build:database: PYTHONPATH=ingestion uv run --python 3.12.13 python -m rule1_ingest.build --root . --output build/rule1.sqlite3
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && PYTHONPATH=ingestion uv run --python 3.12.13 python -m unittest discover -s ingestion/tests -v && pnpm --filter @rule1/web test
scripts.validate:database: PYTHONPATH=ingestion uv run --python 3.12.13 python -m rule1_ingest.validate --root . --database build/rule1.sqlite3
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:database && pnpm validate:database && pnpm build && node scripts/verify-static.mjs
